source: Pipeboard get_google_ads_keyword_ideas, 12 months Oct 2025-Sep 2026, banded; values [worldwide, IN, US+GB+AU+IL+DE+FR]; null = not returned in that geo

kamet.note: 'kamet mountain/peak', 'mount/mt kamet', 'mountain kamet' = one close-variant group (5,400 ww, almost all India; Jan-Feb 2026 6,600). Bare 'kamet' 27,100 is mixed with Kamet whisky (whisky/single malt variants ~1,500 ww) - do not use 27,100 as page demand. Expedition terms tiny (40-50), Aug 2026 spike 110.

changabang.note: Bare 'changabang' 1,000 ww / 590 intl is shared with the Mountain Equipment 'Changabang' jacket (jacket/brand variants ~650 ww). True mountain demand is probably a few hundred a month, mostly UK/US climbers. India 170 (Jun 2026 spike 390). Low volume but strong global-authority entity.

uttarakhand.note: 'highest peak / peaks / mountains / mountaineering in uttarakhand' = one close-variant group (1,900, India-only; May-Jun 2026 2,400-2,900). Intent: India GK ('which is the highest peak of Uttarakhand' = Nanda Devi) + a list. Hotel/resort names with 'peaks' (Peaks and Pine Lansdowne, The White Peaks Nainital) are noise.
